description: The item list of an AccessData AD1 logical image (FTK Imager's custom content image): every file and folder with its size, its modified, accessed and created times, the MD5 and SHA-1 the image records, the SHA-256 of its content and a locator that names it alike in a partial and a whole read, each file inflated to check those digests, and every metadata entry the image keeps. Nothing is extracted: the ad1_extract tool writes the tree out, as a job, and the derived catalogue takes what it writes.
covers: Every item of an unencrypted version 4 AD1 image's tree, its metadata as the image records it, and whether each file's content matches the digests the image records. A logical image holds only what the imager took: no unallocated space, and slack only where it was taken as an item. It opens no file inside the image (ad1_extract writes them out, and the derived catalogue takes them from there), does not decrypt an ADCRYPT image, and reads a segment that is not beside the first, or not in a job's view, as missing.
